close_reason: Added #[derive(Clone, PartialEq, Eq)] to ParseError. All payload fields already satisfy the bounds (DeviationAddError, ParameterError, String, usize, &'static str), so the change is purely additive. 286 pkix-lint tests pass with --all-features; clippy clean. Send+Sync coverage was already added on PKIX-7f92.26.
description:
pkix-lint/src/oscal/parse.rs:43 — ParseError derives only Debug.

AGENTS.md non-negotiable #6 mandates: "Public result/error types ... MUST derive Clone + Debug + PartialEq + Eq and MUST be Send + Sync. They SHOULD support serde::Serialize + Deserialize behind a serde feature flag."

DeviationAddError (deviation.rs:69) DOES derive Clone + PartialEq + Eq + thiserror::Error and complies. ParseError does not. The two error types are returned from adjacent modules in the same crate; the asymmetry is unintentional.

Every payload variant of ParseError is already Clone + PartialEq + Eq compatible:
- String  (Clone + PartialEq + Eq)
- usize   (Clone + PartialEq + Eq)
- &'static str (Clone + PartialEq + Eq)
- DeviationAddError (Clone + PartialEq + Eq via derive)
- crate::ParameterError (Clone + PartialEq + Eq via derive, lib.rs:498)

so adding the derives is mechanical.

CALLER IMPACT: A caller cannot:
- Clone ParseError to log it and propagate it
- Compare ParseError values in test assertions (assert_eq! on Err arms requires PartialEq)
- Persist ParseError across process boundaries via a serialization-cache layer

This is the exact "cache-friendly result types" requirement from non-negotiable #6.

REMEDIATION: Add #[derive(Clone, PartialEq, Eq)] to ParseError. Add a Send+Sync compile-time assertion in the const block at lib.rs:1465 (currently only Finding is asserted; see related finding on Send+Sync coverage gap).

This is a pre-1.0 free fix — adding derives is non-breaking.
title: ParseError missing Clone/PartialEq/Eq derives; violates AGENTS.md non-negotiable #6 cache-friendliness contract
